data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for opening, saving, and selecting directories with native file dialogs
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to open single or multiple files, get save locations, and pick directories across Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows, and Web. It uses platform-specific implementations to show native file pickers.
use_when: Need to let users pick files or directories in a Flutter app
Require cross-platform file selection without custom UI
Need to save files to user-selected locations
avoid_when: You only need to read/write files programmatically without user interaction
You need advanced file system monitoring or watching
strengths: Supports filtering by extensions, MIME types, and UTIs
Offers directory selection and save location APIs
Regularly updated with SDK support changes
weaknesses: No support for iOS <12 or Android <SDK21
No built-in file watching or monitoring
data.setup_notes: Add platform-specific entitlements on macOS for read/write access; include plugin in pubspec; no build_runner needed

alternatives.name: file_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar file selection but with different API surface and may support more platforms

alternatives.name: path_provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Useful for getting platform directories but does not provide file dialogs

data.minimal_example: final XFile? file = await openFile(acceptedTypeGroups: [XTypeGroup(label: 'images', extensions: ['jpg','png'])]);
